content: The data augmentation methods has been applied only for the Japanese INLINEFORM0 Vietnamese direction. For Back Translation, we use Vietnamese monolingual data from VNESEcorpus of DongDu which includes 349578 sentences. We shuffle the lines of VNESEcorpus corpus and take out the first 106758 sentences (the same as the number of sentence pairs in the original parallel corpus). For Mix-Source, instead of using a subsampled monolingual corpus, we use the Vietnamese part of the Japanese-Vietnamese parallel corpus in order to learn the multilingual information in the same domain. Our datasets are listed in Table TABREF14 .
